title: TeamDatasetManifest
description: One generation run (ADR-013 section 4): the commits and hashes it ran under, its public keys, the pilot counts and quota plan, the draw budget and the logs. It is a data record: a reader recomputes nothing here but checks that the cells and splits are sorted and unique and that each split's team count equals its cells' quotas (the contract profile cannot sum). Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is the dataset hash a snapshot lists.

data_class.description: Always synthetic: a team in this system is generated from the pinned engine's data and a recorded seed, never a real team (ADR-013, ADR-008 section 5). The data-class guard refuses a record of this shape without it.

dataset_id.description: A name for the run, unique among datasets.

plan_id.description: The plan whose stream the draws came from; a re-plan gets a fresh id.

generator.description: What the run was made with.

generator_commit.description: The git commit of the generator.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TeamGeneratorConfig.

label_set_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TeamLabelSet.

vocabulary_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TeamVocabulary.

d_max.description: D_max: the draw budget of the plan.

pilot_draws.description: The draws of the recorded pilot.

splits.description: The quota plan per split, sorted by split (dev, validation, training), unique.

reference_pool_hash.description: SHA-256 of the sorted canonical team hashes of every earlier released dataset the run deduplicated against.

rejection_log.description: The log of rejected, duplicate and overflow draws, by reference.

draws.description: Draws made until every bin was full or D_max.

rejections.description: Draws the validator or the round trip refused.

overflows.description: Candidates for a bin that was already full.

VersionManifest.description: Replay identity of a battle (ADR-003, ADR-007): the pinned engine commit, the format, and the hashes of the engine ruleset and of Areneon's own format rules.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine ruleset.

format_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of Areneon's format rules record (ADR-007).

PublicKey.description: The public generation keys. Only a public key may be written to a manifest: a sealed set's key lives in the isolated evaluation store and has no branch here.

generation_key.description: The HMAC key of the draw stream, as hex (public, so any holder can re-derive the stream).

assignment_key.description: The HMAC key that orders each cell when splits are assigned, as hex (public).

SplitPlan.description: The cells of one split, their pilot counts and quotas.

split.description: The split a team belongs to. Sealed teams live only in the isolated evaluation store and have no public split.

teams.description: The split's team count: the sum of its cells' quotas.

cells.description: The cells after the D20 merge, sorted by stratum, unique.

items.description: One cell's pilot count and quota.

pilot_hits.description: Pilot draws that landed in the cell.

quota.description: Teams the cell gets in this split.
